frases.it: Lo spazio di coworking è aperto dal lunedì al venerdì, dalle otto alle venti.
frases.es: El espacio de coworking está abierto de lunes a viernes, de ocho a veinte horas.
frases.en: The coworking space is open from Monday to Friday, from 8 to 20 hours.

frases.it: Per usare la sala riunioni è necessario prenotare almeno un giorno prima.
frases.es: Para usar la sala de reuniones es necesario reservar al menos un día antes.
frases.en: To use the meeting room you need to book at least one day before.

frases.it: Le telefonate sono consentite nelle cabine al primo piano; nella zona comune bisogna parlare a bassa voce.
frases.es: Las llamadas están permitidas en las cabinas de la primera planta; en la zona común hay que hablar en voz baja.
frases.en: The calls are allowed in the cabins on the first floor; in the common area you have to speak in a low voice.

frases.it: Il caffè e le bevande calde sono inclusi, mentre le stampe si pagano a parte.
frases.es: El café y las bebidas calientes están incluidos, mientras que las impresiones se pagan aparte.
frases.en: Coffee and hot drinks are included, while prints are paid for separately.
analisis: le stampe si pagano a parte

frases.it: Gli ospiti esterni possono entrare solo se accompagnati da un membro registrato della struttura.
frases.es: Los invitados externos pueden entrar solo si van acompañados de un miembro registrado del recinto.
frases.en: External guests can enter only if they are accompanied by a registered member of the compound.

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: collaborative work spaces and standards of use

bloques.pregunta: In what days and hours does the coworking space remain open?

opciones.texto: Monday to Friday, from 8: 00 in the morning to 8: 00 in the afternoon.
opciones.explicacion: The rules indicate: «aperto dal lunedì al venerdì, dalle otto alle venti».

opciones.texto: Every day of the week uninterruptedly during the 24 hours.
opciones.explicacion: It does not open weekends or continuous night hours.

opciones.texto: Exclusively on Saturdays and Sundays on tomorrow's schedule.
opciones.explicacion: It remains open only on working days.

bloques.pregunta: What is the requirement to use the office meeting room?

opciones.texto: Make the reservation at least one day in advance.
opciones.explicacion: The rules are: «è necessario prenotare almeno un giorno prima».

opciones.texto: To pay a supplementary cash fee before each session.
opciones.explicacion: It does not mention cash payments per hour but a prior reserve.

opciones.texto: Request special authorization from all the colleagues present.
opciones.explicacion: It requires a formal one-day telematics reserve.

bloques.pregunta: In which specific space of the compound is telephone calls allowed?

opciones.texto: In the individual cabins located on the first floor.
opciones.explicacion: The regulation sets: «Le telefonate sono consentite nelle cabine al primo piano».

opciones.texto: In the common table area without volume limitation.
opciones.explicacion: In the common area it is required to speak with a low voice.

opciones.texto: In the meeting room while other users work.
opciones.explicacion: The calls are concentrated in the soundproofed cabins.

bloques.pregunta: What services or consumptions are covered by the space rate?

opciones.texto: Coffee and hot drinks for users.
opciones.explicacion: The text guarantees: «Il caffè e le bevande calde sono inclusi».

opciones.texto: All impressions and photocopies without page limits.
opciones.explicacion: The prints are invoiced separately («si pagano a parte»).

opciones.texto: The full service of dining and private restaurant.
opciones.explicacion: There is no restaurant service included.

bloques.pregunta: Under what condition can guests from outside access the facilities?

opciones.texto: Only if accompanied by a registered partner or member.
opciones.explicacion: The standard is prescribed: «Gli ospiti esterni possono entrare solo se accompagnati da un membro registrato».

opciones.texto: As long as they pay ten euros at the control counter.
opciones.explicacion: Access to visits requires the support of a partner.

opciones.texto: In any circumstances without any registration.
opciones.explicacion: The rules restrict free access to external services.

bloques.pregunta: How should the voice be modulated when speaking in the common area of work?

opciones.texto: In a low tone to respect the concentration of the partners.
opciones.explicacion: The text expressly orders: «nella zona comune bisogna parlare a bassa voce».

opciones.texto: In a high tone so that all users can hear.
opciones.explicacion: It is directly contrary to the rules of labour silence.
It is allowed to speak whenever it is in a low voice.

bloques.frase: Bisogna parlare a bassa voce nella zona comune
bloques.traduccion: We need to speak out loud in the common area.
bloques.explicacion: Instruction of community coexistence with the impersonal verb «bisogna».

intro: It interprets standards, reserve conditions and living patterns in shared work centres and offices.
